lessons_used: Reordering onboarding sequences is effective (moving sign-in won +12.0%; story-first flow won +3.1%), though impact can be overestimated (+8.0% predicted vs +3.1% measured).
Account safety copy changes on sign-in are helpful (+3.5% won), whereas general intro copy updates showed no clear effect.
UI redesigns carry high risk: redesigning controls hurt performance (-10.1%, worse than predicted -1.0%), while adoption preview redesign showed no clear effect.
Notifications and waiting screen features showed no clear effect, and predictions of +3.0% to +5.0% were too high.

candidates.title: Post-Adoption Account Registration Shift
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step to occur immediately after completing pet adoption selection instead of before it.
candidates.why: Funnel data shows adoption drops significantly (60.9% conversion). Allowing users to select or create their pet first builds ownership before requiring account creation.

sign_in.headline: Save Your New Pet to Your Account
sign_in.body: Sign in now to sync your adoption certificate and keep your pet safe across all devices.

guard.reason: Moving sign-in to occur after adoption is explicitly allowed in onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in after key value steps previously yielded +12.0% lift and targets high adoption drop-off.

candidates.title: Photo Selection Preparation Screen
candidates.change: Insert a photo selection guideline screen before photo upload to explain optimal image lighting and angles.
candidates.why: Support received multiple complaints regarding failed or distorted custom pet generation results during adoption.

new_photo_guidelines.headline: Tips for the Best Custom Pet
new_photo_guidelines.body: Upload a clear, well-lit photo of your pet facing forward for accurate 3D model generation.

guard.reason: Adding a photo guideline screen inside onboarding is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Adding full new screens introduces friction; adoption step redesigns historically regressed (-4.1%).

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Quick-Start Checklist Flow
candidates.change: Add an interactive task checklist step before final home completion detailing how to show, hide, and interact with the desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support received multiple emails from users confused about desktop pet visibility and basic controls after completing setup.

new_desktop_launch_checklist.headline: Essential Desktop Pet Controls
new_desktop_launch_checklist.body: Learn the quick shortcuts to bring your pet to the front or send them to the system tray.

guard.reason: Adding a launch checklist screen before home intro is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Interactive flows on finish step carry high UI redesign risk; past finish control redesign fell -10.1%.

candidates.title: Split Layout Path Choice Overview
candidates.change: Redesign the choose path screen into a side-by-side split comparison of instant adoption versus custom photo creation.
candidates.why: Users take a long average time on path selection (mean 514s), indicating uncertainty between available adoption options.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Adoption Journey
choose_path.body: Choose an instant pre-made companion or generate a custom pet from your photos.

guard.reason: 'choose_path.replace.path_options[0]': a badge cannot do the path_options job (use ['animation', 'button', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'text'])

candidates.title: Account Persistence Safety Reassurance
candidates.change: Update sign-in copy to explicitly confirm existing pets and data will be restored upon logging in.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing back into their accounts.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Access Your Pets
sign_in.body: Your adopted pets and settings are securely linked to your account and will restore automatically.
sign_in.hint: Signing in ensures your desktop pet remains saved.

guard.reason: Updating sign-in copy to reassure account persistence is valid.

candidates.score_note: Account persistence and safety copy updates on sign-in consistently perform well (+3.5% measured).

candidates.title: Custom Photo Quality Guidance Hint
candidates.change: Display an inline hint on the photo upload screen explaining best photo practices to ensure high-quality custom pets.
candidates.why: Three support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual output.

upload_photos.hint: Best results: clear lighting, neutral background, subject centered.

guard.reason: Adding helpful inline photo upload guidance is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Low cost config update, but evidence from support is weak (only 3 tickets) and inline copy has minimal lift.

candidates.title: Pet Generation Time & Progress Indicator
candidates.change: Show estimated remaining time and step progress on the pet preparation waiting screen.
candidates.why: The waiting screen has a high median time (201s) and high mean (2336s), causing drop-off while waiting.

waiting.headline: Crafting Your Desktop Companion...
waiting.body: Your pet is being generated and prepared for your desktop. This usually takes 2-3 minutes.

guard.reason: Adding estimated wait time and progress indicator during real pet generation is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Waiting screen indicators have shown negligible impact (+0.3%) in prior tests despite high waiting times.

candidates.title: Adoption Welcome Treat Incentive
candidates.change: Display a welcome reward badge giving 100 free pet treats upon completing the final onboarding step.
candidates.why: The finish step drops off to 64.8% conversion; an instant in-app reward incentivizes completing setup.

home_intro.headline: Welcome Home! Claim Your 100 Starter Treats
home_intro.body: Your companion has arrived on your desktop with starter treats ready to use.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy cannot mention gifts, treats, or free extras.

candidates.title: Checklist Overview for Final Desktop Introduction
candidates.change: Switch the home intro screen layout to a checklist style displaying basic pet care steps.
candidates.why: Only 64.8% finish the final step, and support emails report confusion regarding pet management after setup.

home_intro.headline: Ready to Start Living with Your Pet
home_intro.body: Follow these steps to feed, interact with, and summon your companion on screen.

guard.reason: Changing the layout of the home intro screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Layout overhauls on the finish step carry strong negative risk (-10.1% in historical finish tests).

candidates.title: Completion Ready Desktop Audio Alert
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification sound and alert when pet generation completes on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: The average waiting step duration is over 38 minutes (2336s mean), indicating users leave the app unattended during processing.

waiting.hint: We will play a chime when your pet lands on your desktop.

guard.reason: Enabling completion audio alert on the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Audio notifications previously resulted in negative conversion (-2.9%) on the home waiting step.

picked: Checklist Overview for Final Desktop Introduction

decisions.title: Checklist Overview for Final Desktop Introduction

lessons_next: Reordering onboarding flows can yield major wins (+12.0%, +3.1%), but can also severely backfire (-8.9%), with positive impacts often overestimated.
Account safety copy changes during sign-in were helpful (+3.5%), whereas general intro copy updates showed no clear effect.
UI redesigns and guides carry high risk, hurting performance far worse than predicted (-10.1% vs -1.0%), while other redesigns showed no clear effect.
Notifications, waiting screens, hints, and checklist layout changes showed no clear effect, making positive predictions (+0.5% to +5.0%) consistently too high.
